text:
tess: starting onboarding for cust Pelagos' LoRA (pelagos-lora-v1) on redwood/venari-13b. adapter includes head-splitting reparam + small scale on value projection. kicking off quick-evalpack (500 samples).
raj: what's the acceptance criteria?
tess: require extraction EM within 2% of baseline, no more than 1% token-boundary anomalies, and no currency token splits. latency/cost unchanged.
mike: quick smoke results: fp16 merge OK, int8 minor diffs, int4 shows currency splits and occasional decimal shifts. sample stats: baseline EM=91.6%, pelagos-int4 EM=88.2% (delta -3.4%), ll_mean delta -0.28.
ci-bot: infra tokenizer version = tok-1.4.2, customer provided tok=tok-1.4.0.
raj: run with customer's tokenizer pinned and stitch overlay instead of hard merge — see if that reduces split rate. also run quant-calib using their token distribution.
tess: doing stitch + calib on dedicated pool now. adding metrics: per-token entropy delta, token-boundary-change-count, and numeric-format-normalization failures.
eval-bot: micro-eval (500) after stitch+calib: EM_drop=1.1%, token_boundary_anomalies=4/500, ll_delta=-0.09. recommended: run full 2k evalpack; if EM_drop >2% prefer venari-13b-int4-safe routing.
mike: logging a few counterexamples for triage: "Total due: $1,200.00" -> "$1,200 .00", "Date: 2026-01-08" -> "2026-1-8". I'll dump per-layer activation diffs to storage.
raj: good. let's also add a checklist entry: "if adapter changes head dims, prefer stitch and quant-calibrate with customer tokenizer" and a CI gate to fail merges that increase token-boundary anomalies >0.5% on 5k calibration set.
tess: agreed. canary queued id=pelagos-canary-3498, ETA ~3h. ping when done and i'll update the customer note with next steps. :rocket:
